responsibility: Main implementation file for the SH target backend. It owns most target hooks and SH-specific code-generation logic, including register-class data, assembler output helpers, PIC/FDPIC address and function-descriptor handling, prologue/epilogue and calling-convention support, instruction costing and scheduling hooks, branch and delay-slot handling, mode-switching for FPSCR state, operand legalization, comparison/branch expansion, and numerous RTL analyses and transformations referenced by the machine descriptions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the SH backend's executable C++ logic and target hooks, whereas sh.h supplies the compile-time target macros/interfaces, sh.md supplies the RTL instruction patterns and attributes that generated code matches against, and sh.opt declares the -m target options that feed this implementation.
